coordinator_email.body:
Hello,

I am writing about a possible candidate for NCT07473700. He is a 68-year-old man with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (UIP pattern on HRCT) and mild emphysema. He has no heart failure.

He already meets the age range and the FVC range (62% predicted). He has been on a stable dose of nintedanib for 1 year. He takes no PDE5 inhibitors, ERAs, sGC stimulators, prostacyclins or sotatercept.

Four items are still open:
1. HRCT date and fibrosis extent (at least 10% within 12 months). We will request the report.
2. Right heart catheterization or echocardiogram within 18 months. We will request any existing study, or arrange an echo.
3. Any history of WHO Group 1, 2, 4 or 5 pulmonary hypertension. We will ask his clinicians.
4. The protocol definition of excluded pulmonary and cardiovascular comorbidities. Could you share it so we can check his emphysema?

He lives in Sacramento. The San Francisco site appears to be the nearest, at about 75 miles. Could you confirm that it is enrolling and tell us the pre-screening steps and who to contact there?

Thank you.

patient_summary.en: This study tests a new medicine for high blood pressure in the lungs. It is for people who also have scarred lungs. You have lung scarring, and your age and breathing test fit the study. A few things are still unknown. We need your recent lung CT scan. We also need a heart test, such as an echo, from the past year and a half. Your doctors should also check that you have no other lung blood pressure problems. We will contact the study team in San Francisco, which is the closest site. Joining is your choice. You can say no or stop at any time.
patient_summary.es: Este estudio prueba un medicamento nuevo para la presión alta en los pulmones. Es para personas que también tienen cicatrices en los pulmones. Usted tiene cicatrices en los pulmones, y su edad y su prueba de respiración encajan con el estudio. Todavía faltan algunos datos. Necesitamos su tomografía reciente del pulmón. También necesitamos una prueba del corazón, como un eco, de los últimos año y medio. Sus médicos también deben confirmar que usted no tiene otros problemas de presión en los pulmones. Nos pondremos en contacto con el equipo del estudio en San Francisco, que es el sitio más cercano. Participar es decisión suya. Puede decir que no o salir del estudio en cualquier momento.
